mechanism: Deutetrabenazine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and sirolimus may have minor effects on CYP3A4 metabolism, with additive CNS depression and potential for increased deutetrabenazine exposure in poor metabolizers.
action: Monitor for increased deutetrabenazine side effects (sedation, hypotension, parkinsonism); consider dose adjustment if CNS symptoms worsen; baseline and periodic monitoring of tolerability recommended.
